aṭṭhamī.g: yato paṭṭhāya Ānandattherassa santike ovādaṁ paṭilabhiṁ, tato paṭṭhāya rattindivamatanditvā vipassanāya kammaṁ karontī rattiyaṁ catukkattuṁ pañcakkhattuṁ vihārato nikkhamitvā manasikāraṁ pavattentī visesaṁ anadhigantvā aṭṭhamiyaṁ rattiyaṁ vīriyasamataṁ labhitvā maggapaṭipāṭiyā kilese khepesinti attho.

Aṭṭhaṁsā.g: tava vasanapāsādesu aṭṭhaṁsā sukatā veḷuriyamayā thambhā.

Aṭṭhaṁsa.g: tava vasanapāsādesu aṭṭhaṁsā sukatā veḷuriyamayā thambhā.

Aṭṭhamako.g: arahattaphalaṭṭhato paṭṭhāya paccorohanagaṇanāya gaṇiyamāno sotāpattimaggaṭṭho aṭṭhamako nāma.

Aṭṭhamaka.g: arahattaphalaṭṭhato paṭṭhāya paccorohanagaṇanāya gaṇiyamāno sotāpattimaggaṭṭho aṭṭhamako nāma.
